findings.title: Loan harness is a test-only disclosed snapshot and moves no financial assets
findings.detail: compactSnapshotHarness emits '// TEST HARNESS ONLY: stores kernel output, never moves financial assets.' and writes disclose(transitionN(...)) into public snapshot cells. Frozen loan/harness.compact and swap/harness.compact are byte-identical SHA-256 1b9a16cc9f3b86c4c28efaf07c16d211240a3d25ef46736417edcc57ed98b174. kernel.compact header states generated restricted Core kernel with no ledger effects or accepted PCD. MAPPING.md states a snapshot is not an asset transfer. contract-info.json marks record0 and record1 pure false / proof true; remaining included arithmetic circuits stay proof false. --skip-zk compiled those proof circuits to ZKIR without keys or proofs.

findings.title: Loan harness compile produced six files including JSON ZKIR 2.0 record0/record1
findings.detail: compile-receipt versions Compact 0.31.1 / language 0.23.0 / runtime 0.16.0 / ledger-8.0.2 with --skip-zk. execve.log binds launcher /home/charl/.local/bin/compact then compactc wrapper then compactc.bin SHA-256 3054ffa89d7a4dfe24afd31c27ef37e87a95757de0fc24485f335635e26dce57, matching the current binary. Compiled tree has exactly six files. Independent parse: record0 num_inputs 39 instructions 255 eleven ops; record1 16/139 eleven ops; union twelve (record0 has mul, record1 has constrain_to_boolean). Observed fields match format-observations.json. Observed opcodes are not a complete normative opcode semantics; the invalid-opcode tool list names 26 variants.

findings.title: Independent midnight-zkir 2.1.0 mock-compile accepted both frozen circuits
findings.detail: Tool /home/charl/.compact/versions/0.31.1/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/zkir SHA-256 5443f87db07b7f19cc273380c224b77b4b7ca124deac6d54f7a165628fc5e1fc and --version midnight-zkir 2.1.0 match the frozen mock receipt before replay. Each input.zkir was copied byte-identically into unique review directories. valid-record0 exit 0, not timeout, stderr k=13 rows=5297, emitted input.bzkir 955 bytes SHA-256 d1217f2fe66662dce7e0df9eac73ede27406d43704bdfd0f455128ca8a3abb7d exact match. valid-record1 exit 0, k=12 rows=2941, 395 bytes SHA-256 f02506aea4a31d7db9bd3526ca65c6173b9fa08d5bc26a5368c61ce36f73684d exact match. This run showed no bzkir nondeterminism. No keys or proofs were generated. Compiler was not rerun.

findings.title: Three negative format controls reject as disclosed
findings.detail: invalid-version999 major 999 exit 1: invalid value integer 999 expected u8. unsupported-inrange-version255 major 255 exit 1: Unhandled version 255.0. invalid-opcode first op root_invalid_opcode_control exit 1: unknown variant, expected listed variants. Timeouts false. These controls show selected parse/version/opcode checks. They do not prove constraint soundness, witness validity, verification, or settlement.

findings.detail: Frozen mock stderr names the original author working directory under p31-zkir-artifact-preparation. Independent replay stderr names review/replay/mock-compile/... . k/rows and error texts otherwise match. Stdout remains empty SHA-256 e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855. Original frozen bytes are retained; replay bytes are retained separately. This is path embedding, not a circuit or result change.

findings.title: Frozen records do not claim adapter 32.7, P31, or correspondence
findings.detail: README, compile-receipt, root-observations, materialization-comparison, and mock receipts set acceptance false. They disclose test-only snapshots, skip-zk, mock-only compilation, and that observed opcodes are not a complete schema. No actual claim in these records was found to overstate the evidence. This review does not invent extra gates for that disclosed test scope.

findings.title: Usable artifact/interface evidence; semantic contract still required before 32.7
findings.detail: Root-accepted tasks 32.1-32.4 are not reopened. Task 32.3 remains the blocked_unavailable gap record. These artifacts supply the named next action of capturing generated ZKIR plus source/tool identity. Remaining before adapter 32.7: a verified JSON 2.0 interface/semantic contract (opcode meanings, public-input/witness layout, communications commitment); Compact kernel/harness to ZKIR correspondence distinct from materialization identity; implement proposed lean/DefiKernel/Adapters/ZKIR.lean against that pin or keep blocked_unavailable. Mock-compile success does not accept 32.7, full P31, P20-dependent PCT, constraint soundness, or the program.
